test_title: PYST 51: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper offers a discount of 20% on a shirt marked at 1500. What is the selling price of the shirt?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of the shirt = Rs. 1500

Discount offered = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price - (Discount % × Marked Price)

**Calculation:**

Discount amount = 20% of 1500

Discount amount = (20/100) × 1500

⇒ Discount amount = 0.2 × 1500

⇒ Discount amount = Rs. 300

Selling Price = Marked Price - Discount amount

⇒ Selling Price = 1500 - 300

⇒ Selling Price = Rs. 1200

**The selling price of the shirt is Rs. 1200.**
